preservation_findings: Note 849 is a strong applied case packet for London transport: it tests a bounded functional transport authority inside a metropolitan democratic shell.

Note 615 is not merely a London/TfL case. It supplies a general service-home grammar for any shared territorial tier that must plan, commission, operate, regulate, or keep services running across local boundaries.

The London packet preserves part of the asset-heavy transport example but does not yet preserve the generic authority/operator/regulator split, territorial service-map requirement, near-to-person front-door rule, and failure-takeover service constitution for other sectors.

Therefore note 615 is not deletion-ready. A future absorption patch could move 615 only into a generalized service-home module or cross-boundary service packet that preserves the protected elements and points 849 to the applied transport instance.

preservation_findings: Note 858 preserves a procedural interoperability-assessment waist, not the generic decision object that changes a right, duty, status, payment, service access, or appeal position.

Note 857 can ledger claims and source currentness, but a claim record is not a decision packet unless it carries determination class, authority, reason, effectivity, implementation, review, and lineage fields.

Deleting or absorbing note 720 into note 858 would collapse outcome-letter, assessment-form, and decision-object governance into one surface and would lose cross-domain administrative procedure grammar.
